title: Zero-shot evaluation of open vision-language models as System 1 decision models on radiology tasks
abstract: arXiv:2611.01631v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Purpose: To compare two multimodal System 1 decision models (Clef 27B, d1 3B) with three generative vision-language models read out zero-shot from a single answer token (Qwen3.8-27B, which is Clef's backbone; Gemma 4 31B; MedGemma 1.5 4B) on seven radiology tasks. Methods: All models ran locally on one NVIDIA DGX Spark. The System 1 models returned a probability for each option in one pass; for the generative models, probabilities were read from the log-probabilities of the option letters. Tasks covered chest CT and radiograph reports (CT-RATE, PadChest), device MR safety records (GUDID), tubes and lines on chest radiographs (RANZCR CLiP), chest CT volumes (CT-RATE), brain MRI motion (MR-ART) and MRI sequence (BraTS 2021), 4,435 cases in total. The primary endpoint was AUROC with bootstrap 95% CIs. Results: All five models retrieved report findings well (AUROC 0.93-0.99). Clef ranked higher than its backbone on CT volumes (0.74

translated_title: 开放视觉-语言模型作为系统1决策模型在放射学任务上的零样本评估
translated_abstract: 目的：比较两种多模态系统1决策模型（Clef 27B、d1 3B）与三种生成式视觉-语言模型（Qwen3.8-27B，即Clef的骨干模型；Gemma 4 31B；MedGemma 1.5 4B）在七项放射学任务上的零样本表现，其中生成式模型从单个答案标记中读取零样本输出。方法：所有模型均在一台NVIDIA DGX Spark上本地运行。系统1模型在单次前向传播中返回每个选项的概率；对于生成式模型，概率则从选项字母的对数概率中读取。任务涵盖胸部CT和X线报告（CT-RATE、PadChest）、器械MR安全记录（GUDID）、胸片上的管路和线缆（RANZCR CLiP）、胸部CT体积（CT-RATE）、脑部MRI运动伪影（MR-ART）以及MRI序列识别（BraTS 2021），共计4,435例病例。主要终点指标为AUROC，并采用bootstrap法计算95%置信区间。结果：所有五个模型在报告发现检索方面均表现良好（AUROC 0.93-0.99）。Clef在CT体积任务上的表现优于其骨干模型（0.74...
tldr: 该研究在一台本地设备上对系统1决策模型与生成式视觉-语言模型在七项放射学任务上进行了零样本对比评估，发现所有模型在报告检索任务上表现优异（AUROC 0.93-0.99），而专门的系统1决策模型在CT体积等感知型任务上优于其生成式骨干模型。
en_tdlr: This study benchmarked System 1 decision models against generative vision-language models zero-shot across seven radiology tasks on a single local device, showing all models performed well on report retrieval (AUROC 0.93-0.99), with the dedicated System 1 model outperforming its generative backbone on perception-heavy tasks like CT volumes.
